authoring_status: Independently authored synthetic laboratory declarations and source-cited expectations; not human/client-validated gold.
declaration_policy: Freeze this finite fictional lab before inference. Do not derive capabilities from predicted outputs, change values after observing predictions, or seed/replace any existing client laboratory. Method metadata contains identity only; no standard body text or method-equivalence claim.
pricing_note: All USD prices are fictional test rates for demonstration only; they are not a client quote.
expected_summary: Contains supported measurement/conditions, deliberate finite operating gaps, genuinely unrecorded reporting capability, and methods not offered. Extraction/source-review warnings are independent of laboratory coverage and must remain visible.

expectations.requested: 20° measurement; horizontal >=88 GU and vertical >=85 GU.
expectations.scope: Measurement/reporting coverage, not a guarantee that the specimen passes.

expectations.requested: 2 mm cross-cut spacing; report GT 0 to 1.
expectations.scope: Atomic spacing and reportable classification; whole-test result also depends on all bake/substrate requirements.

expectations.lab_declaration: 750 g; observed pencil grades include F and neighboring grades.
expectations.scope: Ability to measure/report the requested grade does not predict specimen hardness.
Temperature gap; 10 cm = 100 mm and 60 s are supported.

expectations.lab_declaration: CH, maximum continuous duration 168 h, chamber 20–60°C.
expectations.scope: Known duration shortfall; no extrapolation from 168 h to 240 h.
Exposure condition coverage; post-exposure observations remain separately assessed.

expectations.requested: 1000 h; scribe creep <=2 mm on CRS and <=1 mm on galvanized steel.
expectations.lab_declaration: Up to 2000 h exposure; creep measurement and resolution remain unknown.
expectations.scope: A supported exposure cannot imply unrecorded reporting ability.

expectations.requested: 0.55 W/m² at 340 nm; 3000 kJ/m²; gloss/defects and Section 4.4 color assessment.
expectations.lab_declaration: Irradiance and dose covered, gloss/visual reports available, multi-angle color reporting undeclared.
expectations.scope: Missing measurement declaration stays unknown; do not infer another color service.
No method borrowing from neutral salt spray.
Accelerated xenon/UV do not imply outdoor service.

expectations.requested: 1 kg, 20 mm direct-impact indenter and 50 cm drop.
expectations.lab_declaration: 1 kg, 20 mm direct impact, drop range 0–100 cm.
expectations.scope: Condition and observation coverage, not a promise of a passing panel.
